properties.notes: Site is an adopted housing allocation in the adopted Fareham Local Plan Part 2 (2015) and proposed for retention in Draft Local Plan (2017). This identifies an indicative capacity of 35 dwellings for the site. However, an indicative capacity of 13 dwellings per hectare has been calculated at this stage for the previously developed part of the site as per the site boundary. Site is located on the edge of Locks Heath District Centre.. http://www.fareham.gov.uk/PDF/planning/local_plan/DraftLocalPlanEvidenceBase/EV11-SHLAAOct2017.pdf
